json_schema.title: cp.get_url
json_schema.description: Used to get a single file from a URL

path.ui:title: Path
path.ui:description: A URL to download a file from. Supported URL schemes are: salt://, http://, https://, ftp://, s3://, swift:// and file:// (local filesystem). If no scheme was specified, this is equivalent of using file://. If a file:// URL is given, the function just returns absolute path to that file on a local filesystem. The function returns False if Salt was unable to fetch a file from a salt:// URL

dest.ui:title: Destination
dest.ui:description: The default behaviour is to write the fetched file to the given destination path. If this parameter is omitted or set as empty string (''), the function places the remote file on the local filesystem inside the Minion cache directory and returns the path to that file

saltenv.ui:title: Salt Environment
saltenv.ui:description: Salt fileserver environment from which to retrieve the file. Ignored if path is not a salt:// URL

source_hash.ui:title: Source Hash
source_hash.ui:description: If path is an http(s) or ftp URL and the file exists in the minion's file cache, this option can be passed to keep the minion from re-downloading the file if the cached copy matches the specified hash
